##### Project general facts

Lamaa by Meraas is the sixth phase of the prestigious Madinat Jumeirah Living community, offering a collection of 1- to 4-bedroom apartments across four elegant residential buildings. Each building features a ground floor and nine residential levels, with a total of 372 residences thoughtfully designed for modern and comfortable living. The architecture combines an elegant exterior with refined interiors, while private balconies and terraces provide views of the lush MJL landscaping and the iconic Burj Al Arab. The 3- and 4-bedroom residences also include a maid’s room for added convenience.

The development offers a wide range of amenities designed to support an active and comfortable lifestyle. Residents can enjoy swimming pools, state-of-the-art fitness centres, a nursery, children’s play areas, landscaped parks, open spaces, and a central pedestrian walkway ideal for leisurely strolls. The surrounding community also provides convenient access to supermarkets, banks, medical facilities, restaurants, cafés, and other everyday essentials.

The residences feature thoughtfully designed interiors crafted with high-quality materials, creating an elegant and comfortable living environment. Spacious layouts are complemented by private balconies and terraces that extend the living spaces outdoors and enhance the connection with the landscaped surroundings. The development combines contemporary design, practical layouts, and premium details to provide a refined residential experience.

##### Location description and benefits

Madinat Jumeirah Living is an exclusive residential community that captures the charm of traditional Arabian architecture blended seamlessly with modern luxury. Nestled in the heart of Dubai and just moments from the iconic Burj Al Arab, it offers residents a peaceful sanctuary surrounded by lush landscaping and meandering walkways. With its timeless design and refined ambiance, Madinat Jumeirah Living stands as one of Dubai’s most desirable addresses for those seeking tranquility and prestige.

Life in Madinat Jumeirah Living is enhanced by a wealth of lifestyle amenities thoughtfully designed to promote relaxation and well-being. Residents can enjoy shaded courtyards, fitness centers, children’s play areas, and serene community gardens that encourage a healthy and active lifestyle. Every element within the community reflects meticulous attention to detail, creating a setting where comfort, beauty, and convenience come together harmoniously.

Beyond its elegant residences and amenities, Madinat Jumeirah Living offers an exceptional location that connects residents to Dubai’s most prestigious landmarks. Within walking distance lies Souk Madinat Jumeirah, with its waterfront dining, boutique shopping, and charming canals. The area also provides easy access to Jumeirah Beach, major business hubs, and top international schools, making it ideal for families and professionals alike.
